            "triton" if node_mask & (1 << i) else "triton_compute"

            "triton_memory" if decoder_mask & (1 << i) else "triton_compute"

    grad_values=torch.empty(rows,width,device=edge.device,dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    grad_update=empty()
    grad_norm_weight,grad_norm_bias=zeros(width),zeros(width)
    grad_output_bias,grad_hidden_bias=zeros(width),zeros(width)
    grad_bias_scratch=zeros(width)
    grad_query=zeros(nodes*width).view(nodes,width)
    neighbors=tail._neighbors_of(rows,nodes)
    tiles,whole_rows=tail._tile_grid(rows,width),tail._rows_grid(rows)
    tail._norm_backward[whole_rows](grad_out,values,keep,gamma,grad_values,grad_update,
        grad_norm_weight,grad_norm_bias,grad_output_bias,rows,tail._shape_key(rows),scale,eps,
        WIDTH=width,DROPOUT=dropout)
    grad_hidden,activated_hidden=empty(),empty()
    tail._project_backward[tiles](grad_update,w3,hidden,grad_hidden,activated_hidden,
        grad_hidden_bias,rows,tail._shape_key(rows),WIDTH=width,EMIT_BIAS=True)
    grad_w3=grad_update.t() @ activated_hidden
    del grad_update,activated_hidden
    grad_preactivation,activated=empty(),empty()
    tail._project_backward[tiles](grad_hidden,w2,preactivation,grad_preactivation,activated,
        grad_bias_scratch,rows,tail._shape_key(rows),WIDTH=width,EMIT_BIAS=False)
    grad_w2=grad_hidden.t() @ activated
    del grad_hidden,activated
    grad_edge=empty()

        rows,nodes,tail._shape_key(rows,NEIGHBORS=neighbors),W1_ROW_STRIDE=w1_row_stride,
        NEIGHBORS=neighbors,WIDTH=width)
    del grad_values
    grad_w1=grad_preactivation.t() @ edge
    grad_neighbor=torch.ops.aten.embedding_dense_backward(grad_preactivation,index,nodes,-1,False)
    return grad_edge,grad_query,grad_neighbor,grad_w1,grad_w2,grad_w3,grad_hidden_bias,grad_output_bias,grad_norm_weight,grad_norm_bias
